short: Face Cutout (M03) is ahead but untested on mouth crops; the face RoI (M05) is standard, as face and mouth were compared before; the GRID 2.9% claim relies on an LM.
position: The paper [@zhang2020beyond] changes the input region (M05) and the training augmentation (M03). Face Cutout is ahead: none of 172 prior decoders masks input patches, and it helps on LRW and GRID, with LRW-1000 initialised from LRW. The face RoI is standard: full-face and mouth features had been compared in lip reading before, with the mouth winning [@cox2008multispeaker; @neti2000jsalt]; the reversal holds on LRW-1000 and GRID but not on LRW when aligned. Cutout is never applied to mouth crops, so its gain is not tied to extraoral cues. The GRID 2.9% WER uses a 5-gram LM, while the uncompared LCANet reports the same figure with no LM stated [@xu2018lcanet].
